editorial.blurb: A genuine spot where warm service matches outstanding flavors, from exceptional asada and fresh mariscos to craveable enchiladas and traditional horchata.
editorial.insiderTip: Look toward the back of the menu for budget-friendly options if you want to stretch your dollar, and don't skip their new breakfast menu—it's become a local favorite.

topDishes.note: Absolutely favorite, incredibly fresh and authentic
